hypothesis: A scene-independent readout can recover the historical raw-gauge text capability without an implicit train/deployment mismatch when RADIO direction and raw norm are separately identified, sparse deployment support is represented during training, and minimum support recovery is explicit rather than mislabeled as semantic membership.

single_method_change.base: frozen SurfaceRegion V2 method and frozen benchmark protocols
single_method_change.candidate: SurfaceRegion V3 direction-plus-log-norm carrier, eligible-induced tiered support recovery, support-fill reliability, and matched sparse-support training
forbidden: threshold, graph, radius, or solver sweep
loading a V2 readout into V3
using support-fill as semantic membership or tensor padding

training_contract.source: ScanNet RGB-D-pose only, benchmark physical spaces excluded
training_contract.teacher: frozen V2 fixed-core official C-RADIO crop targets replayed exactly
training_contract.raw_norm_source: fresh raw spatial RADIO observations before voxel-fused direction normalization
training_contract.sparse_augmentation: SHA256(seed,epoch,region_id) log-uniform token prefix from 24 to available

benchmark_sequence.first: LERF3D Figurines frozen VALA direct3D threshold-0.6 sentinel
benchmark_sequence.full_lerf_opening: only after the primary floor and all generic gates pass

failure_actions.generic_gate_failure: do not open benchmark; diagnose representation/training only
failure_actions.figurines_failure: do not open full4 and do not tune the scene; decompose base score calibration and carrier/readout distribution
failure_actions.success: freeze the exact field/readout/contract hashes before other benchmark evaluation
